chunks: And from him, from Safwan, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
"There is no harm in delaying the visitation of the House until the Day of Departure (Yawm al-Nafra); it is merely recommended to hasten it out of fear of unforeseen events and obstructions."

key_terms.يَوْمِ النَّفْرِ: The Day of Departure (10th of Dhu al-Hijjah)

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to delay visiting the Kaaba until the Day of Departure during Hajj?
ai.summary: Transmitted via the chain of Safwan al-Jarrah, a key companion of Imam al-Sadiq, this hadith clarifies the flexibility of Hajj rituals by distinguishing between the recommended haste (ta'jil) to avoid crowds and the permissibility of delaying until Yawm al-Nafra. It reflects the Shia juristic principle of ease (yusr), prioritizing the completion of the ritual over strict timing, provided no obligatory element is missed.
